articles.headline: Sources: Cowboys acquire OT Jones in exchange for two draft picks
articles.description: The Steelers are sending 2023 first-round pick Broderick Jones and a fourth-rounder to the Cowboys in exchange for a future third- and sixth-round pick, sources told ESPN.

articles.headline: Jacksonville Jaguars acquire Quinn Ewers from Miami Dolphins
articles.description: On Saturday, the Jacksonville Jaguars traded for quarterback Quinn Ewers, 23, who played in four games last season and completed 66.3% of his passes, sending a sixth-round pick in 2028 to the Miami Dolphins for the second-year player, the teams announced.

articles.headline: Source: Panthers agree with veteran LB Bobby Okereke
articles.description: The Carolina Panthers agreed to terms on a one-year deal with veteran inside linebacker Bobby Okereke on Saturday, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

articles.headline: Source: Bills cut punter Wishnowsky; Hardman also released
articles.description: The Bills are releasing veteran returner and wide receiver Mecole Hardman Jr. A source confirmed to ESPN that the team is also releasing punter Mitch Wishnowsky.

articles.headline: Giants trade for DT CJ Okoye from Ravens for '28 draft pick
articles.description: Defensive tackle CJ Okoye, 24, will reunite with Giants coach John Harbaugh, after the Baltimore Ravens dealt the veteran reserve to New York for a 2028 seventh-round pick, the teams announced Saturday afternoon.

articles.headline: Matt LaFleur: 'Fully anticipate' Josh Jacobs being on team amid charges
articles.description: Packers coach Matt LaFleur addressed Josh Jacobs' future with the team Friday, one day after the running back was charged with two misdemeanors related to an alleged incident earlier this year with a woman at his home.

articles.headline: Cowboys' Marist Liufau to miss time after fracturing forearm
articles.description: Cowboys outside linebacker Marist Liufau is scheduled to have surgery as early as Monday on a fractured left forearm he suffered in Friday's preseason finale. Coach Brian Schottenheimer said Liufau would miss "weeks," but Jerry Jones was more optimistic.

articles.headline: Giants' Harbaugh: Beckham has 'done enough' to make NFL roster
articles.description: Odell Beckham Jr. had three catches for 53 yards in the Giants' preseason finale, after which coach John Harbaugh said he believes the wide receiver has "done enough to make an NFL roster."

articles.headline: Bucs GM Jason Licht 'optimistic' about re-signing Baker Mayfield
articles.description: Buccaneers general manager Jason Licht said Friday that he is "very optimistic" about quarterback Baker Mayfield playing in Tampa beyond the 2026 season despite Mayfield saying he felt "disrespected" by the Bucs' initial offer.

articles.description: Jalon Daniels’ chances of earning Tampa Bay’s backup quarterback job seemed to diminish in the team’s preseason finale, a 19-0 loss at Jacksonville on Friday night in which neither side played starters.
